name: tags_by_sequence
note: StockScrapReasonTag._order = 'sequence, id' (addons/stock/models/stock_scrap_reason_tag.py:7): the stock.move scrap_reason_tag_ids widget lists tags in that order with their colour; whole population
source_sql: SELECT id, name->>'en_US' AS name, sequence, color FROM stock_scrap_reason_tag ORDER BY sequence, id

name: tag_names_unique
note: _name_uniq constraint unique(name) (addons/stock/models/stock_scrap_reason_tag.py:13) mirrored by the unique index on name: one tag per translated name
source_sql: SELECT name->>'en_US' AS name, count(*) AS tags FROM stock_scrap_reason_tag GROUP BY name->>'en_US' ORDER BY name->>'en_US'
